title: Points of Judgement: a Club Tier Against the Priced Places of a Re-Worked Vacation Package
content:
The priced places of a re-worked package among the Vacation Package Products carry a club rate, and a Wanderlane Traveller Club membership held by the traveller may lower it. The date the membership's next tier review falls, measured against the departure date shown on the package record, decides which limb applies.

**When is the tier's own percentage taken in full?**

Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier carries a package discount and whose next tier review falls after the departure date, the club rate is the whole of them less the package discount percentage that tier carries. A review falling strictly after the departure date satisfies this limb.

**When is only part of it taken?**

Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier carries a package discount and whose next tier review falls on or before the departure date, the club rate is the whole of them less that percentage taken at the review-pending share published for this calculation, which is 50 per cent. A review falling on the departure date itself belongs to this limb, not the one above.

**When does neither apply?**

Where no such membership stands active, or the tier it stands at carries a package discount of nil, the club rate is not lowered on this ground.

| Membership standing | Tier's package discount | Next tier review against the departure date | Taken off the club rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active | above nil | after it | the tier's package discount percentage in full |
| active | above nil | on or before it | that percentage taken at 50 per cent |
| active | nil | either | nothing on this ground |
| not active | either | either | nothing on this ground |

*Worked hypothetically.* Priced places of 4,000.00 USD and a membership standing active at a tier carrying a package discount of 10 per cent, whose next review falls a month after departure: the club rate leaves 3,600.00 USD. With the same tier reviewed on the departure date itself, the percentage is taken at 50 per cent, giving 5 per cent, and the club rate leaves 3,800.00 USD.
